title: Fourier positivity for spherical functions I: split tori and spherical principal series
summary: We prove Fourier positivity for spherical functions on a semisimple linear algebraic group $G$ over a local field restricted to its split tori $A$ for unitary principal series parameters of $G$. For ${\rm SL}_n(F)$, where $F$ is a local field, we obtain an explicit recursive formula for the Fourier transform on the diagonal split torus in terms of local Rankin--Selberg factors for ${\rm GL}_n\times {\rm GL}_{n-1}$, together with uniform exponential lower bounds in the spectral parameters.
